queer_characters.name: Pie
queer_characters.notes: Described as a closeted young lesbian from a conservative family who ultimately chooses to openly pursue her relationship with Kim, ending happily.

queer_characters.name: Kim
queer_characters.notes: An openly masculine 'tom' (butch lesbian) student; the source notes this as the first Thai lesbian-genre film with a 'tom' lead. The 'tom' identity in Thai culture can carry gender-nonconforming dimensions, but the source labels her a butch lesbian.
queer_characters.contest_notes: Source describes Kim as a butch lesbian ('tom'); the 'tom' label may be read by some as a masculine/gender-nonconforming identity rather than strictly lesbian, but the text does not resolve this.

contributor_notes: Kim's 'transgender' tag is speculative and flagged as contested — the source explicitly calls her a butch lesbian 'tom,' and a maintainer should verify whether the transgender reading is appropriate or should be removed. Content warnings drawn from listed parental rejection based on orientation (homophobia) and suicidal ideation. Emotional manipulation/coercion and jealousy were noted but did not map cleanly to the trigger-warning enum. Spicy level set to 1 as no explicit content is indicated; adjust if the film contains more.
